description: This file defines an Android Service called SyncService that manages the lifecycle of a SyncAdapter instance, providing a binder for synchronization requests. It includes methods for initialization, destruction, and binding, with internal synchronization to ensure thread safety.

classes.name: SyncService
classes.description: An Android Service that manages a singleton SyncAdapter instance and provides binder access for synchronization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the SyncAdapter instance in a thread-safe manner and logs service creation.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder object for IPC communication with the SyncAdapter.
